summary: Snikket provides a complete, containerised XMPP communication platform packaged with a web administration interface and client applications. It allows you to host your own federated messaging infrastructure using container orchestration. The service bundles server and client tooling into a unified deployment to simplify administration.
goodFor: Administrators who want to set up an independent, self-hosted XMPP communication service without configuring every component individually.
watchOut: The repository currently has no tagged releases and a low computed maintenance score, indicating potential risks regarding long-term updates and stability.
deployNotes: Because the service runs via Docker, you will typically need persistent volumes for data storage and a reverse proxy to handle external TLS termination.
